sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: This script's items in Event Horizon's menus ("Open in ShowAllEntityData", "SAED: Show all Tracks for Release", …) now carry a small table icon, so an item you move from ⋯ into Event Horizon's main row no longer shows as words only. It reads on light and dark themes, and costs no request.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: Help: a paragraph on String Theory's idle mode (a random theme and an animated effect over the page after five minutes without input, our tables included): what it costs and where in String Theory's settings to switch it off or give it a longer time.
